_comment: Dataset sintetico per test adapter Last.fm (Story 1.3, Sessione 52). Copre i casi minimi della spec 03-ADAPTERS/lastfm.md par.8 lato API: happy path, paginazione, E.LF.1 (nowplaying senza date), E.LF.14 (artist stringa vs oggetto), E.LF.5 (mbid vuoto), E.LF.17 (loved), E.LF.9 (scarti). 5 track: 4 importate, 1 scartata.

_metadata.expectedDedupRules: 02-DATA-SCHEMA par.5: DEDUP-2 mbid:<mbid> quando presente, altrimenti DEDUP-3 fuzzy con durationBucketMs = 0 (Last.fm non espone la durata).

_expectedOutput._comment: Derivazione interna come canone (par.8). eventKey = 'lastfm:' + <YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM> + '|' + (mbid ?? name + '|' + artist).
_expectedOutput._skippedNowPlayingDerivation: track E_LF_1_nowplaying (@attr.nowplaying = 'true', nessun date) -> scartata in silenzio, nessun warning
_expectedOutput._uniqueTracksDerivation: 4 eventi importati: 'Apocalypse Dreams' (mbid mbid-track-1) e 'So What' (mbid vuoto -> DEDUP-3) e 'Borderline' (mbid mbid-track-3) e 'Airbag' (artist stringa, DEDUP-3): 4 brani distinti
_expectedOutput._mbidMissingDerivation: 2 track senza mbid (E.LF_5_mbid_empty e E_LF_14_artist_as_string) -> un solo warning aggregato mbidMissing con count = 2

album.#text: Music Has the Right to Children
